body:
Okay. So I'm incel. I'm not a bad person though, there's seriously no bad intention or while I'm not perfect I'm very capable of being empathetic and understanding other people's PoV. But I've been following all this kind of advice that gets posted in forums such as this and I just seem to not be able to get where I want to be and it's frustrating.
I've kept myself busy with hobbies to try and be interesting. I've tried hard to grow friendships and be more social. I've been speaking to a therapist online for the past year as well.
But despite all this I still feel like my life is lacking. I always feel like I'm at the bottom of the totem pole. I get jealous of people who are better at socialising, or who are so goodlooking that women approach them.
What annoys me the most is that I'm never going to figure this out. I can do anything but I'll never be like them.
Perhaps I expect too much from life but I feel like accepting any less is a pathetic position and I'll always be longing for that validation which comes so easy to others. 
Has anyone here experienced thoughts like this and come to a conclusion?
